{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion fraction: number of converted / total
converted_count = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(loyal_df)
conversion_fraction = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Converted: {converted_count}")
print(f"Total: {total_count}")
print(f"Conversion fraction: {conversion_fraction}")"}
